findings.description: The bucket is explicitly indicated as public and has no ACL or public-access-block configuration to prevent public reads or writes. This can expose the customer-master spreadsheet and any other bucket data to unauthorised internet users.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined. Objects in this bucket, including sensitive customer data, are not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined for this financial-data bucket, so stored objects are not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined, leaving operational data without an enforced encryption-at-rest control.
No default server-side encryption configuration is defined, so data-science objects are not guaranteed to be encrypted at rest.
